title: Signalboard SaaS Landing
tagline: A dark, technical landing page for developer tools and analytics products.
description:
Signalboard is a launch-ready landing page for a developer-facing SaaS product. The hero pairs a waitlist form with a live, self-updating SVG chart; below it sit a numbered feature grid, accessible code-sample tabs, a pricing table with a monthly/yearly switch, an FAQ and a closing call to action.

The waitlist form works in two modes: demo mode validates and confirms locally, and setting VITE_WAITLIST_ENDPOINT posts sign-ups as JSON to your own endpoint or form service.

Built with Vite, React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS 4, with no other runtime dependencies.
requirements: Optional: a form endpoint for waitlist sign-ups
technologyNotes: Vite 8 single-page app with one optional build-time variable (VITE_WAITLIST_ENDPOINT). Output is static.
